name: (unnamed)
summary: The Versatile mid-class orbital vehicle — a scaled-up EX-3, roughly twice its capability, on two TX-04 boosters. Sizing not yet worked.
description: VX-13 is the Versatile-class step between the EX and LX orbital vehicles: a larger EX-3, with more of its own propellant and somewhat interior-capable modules. The fleet doc places it as “VX-13 > EX-3” and “LX-23 > VX-13.” Detailed sizing has not yet been done.

specs.note: Twice the EX-3 on twice the boosters, plus more own fuel and interior-capable modules.

capabilities.name: Mid-class orbital delivery
capabilities.detail: Bridges the EX-3 (10 t) and LX-23 (50 t) — a ~20–25 t class on two boosters. Somewhat interior-capable modules (more than EX, less than LX station volume).

sections.heading: Status
sections.body: VX-13 is teased in the fleet doc but not engineered. Payload class (~20–25 t), two-booster stack, and interior-capable modules are placeholders pending a real sizing pass.

openItems: Full sizing pass: dry mass, propellant, per-stage Δv on 2× TX-04.
